d:
Located in the desirable and quiet neighborhood of Chotrana 1, La Soukra, this beautiful S2 apartment offers comfort, convenience, and modern living. It is ideally situated close to coffee shops, pharmacies, grocery stores, and many other essential amenities.
The apartment features a spacious living room combined with an open-plan American-style kitchen, fully equipped with an oven, stove, and range hood.
It includes two private bedrooms, each with built-in closets and pleasant outdoor views. All rooms are fitted with air conditioning and built-in gas heaters, ensuring year-round comfort.
The residence is a relatively small, well-maintained complex that offers the privacy and tranquility of a private villa. Residents benefit from a 24/7 concierge service, CCTV security, and one assigned underground parking space included with the apartment.
This apartment is an excellent choice for anyone seeking a peaceful home in a prime location with easy access to everyday conveniences.
